# Supabase browser SDK

Supabase JS 2.117.2 (MIT), from the npm package `@supabase/supabase-js`:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/dist/umd/supabase.js

SHA256: 59D39487C3589843B410322D8A3D562CE022ABA1E5CCB16898EF3FB2A0DA2ECD

Vendored to avoid runtime CDN dependency. It manages authentication sessions,
refresh and cross-tab auth events; the application does not implement password storage.
